about: The coverage table the MCP parity gate checks. Every owner-facing route in the contract's HTTP surface is listed here once, and every entry says which of three things it is. `paired`: a registered MCP tool performs the same operation on the same objects, and names it. `listed`: the route is not agent-operable yet, and says why it is not and which spec will pair it — a listed route is the visible backlog, not a silent gap. `exempt`: the route is not an owner capability an agent should have, and says why; ADR 0013 allows an exemption for an auth flow or a pure-UI read and for nothing else. A route that is not in this table fails the gate, so a new human-only route cannot be added to the contract without being answered for here.
